header.title: My Documents
header.subtitle: Your own paperwork — registration, licences, certificates, contracts and identity documents. Private to you.

notices.privateTitle: These documents are private to you
notices.privateBody: Nobody else at this clinic can open them, list them, or see that they exist — administrators included. There is no permission that can be granted to change that.
notices.notUsedByAssistant: The AI assistant never reads these files. They are stored and served to you and are not sent to any AI provider — unlike your knowledge base, which is.
notices.noPatientData: Do not put a patient's records here. A patient's file belongs in their record, where their care team and the retention rules can reach it — filed here it would be invisible to everyone, including them.

states.error: Could not load your documents. Try again in a moment.
states.emptyDescription: Add your STR, SIP, ijazah or any other paperwork you want to keep somewhere safe.
states.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search term or category. Clearing the filters shows everything again.

upload.title: Add a document
upload.description: The file is stored for you and served back only to you. Everything below the file is optional — you can fill it in later.

fields.fileHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB.
fields.title: Title

errors.unsupportedType: That file type is not accepted. Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.backwardsDates: The expiry date cannot come before the issue date.
errors.failed: The upload failed. Try again in a moment.

edit.title: Edit document
edit.description: Your own notes about this document. The file itself does not change — nothing here is checked against any register.

errors.backwardsDates: The expiry date cannot come before the issue date.

confirm.delete: Delete “{title}” permanently? The file and everything about it are removed for good — there is no copy anyone can restore.

sharing.revocationLimit: Revoking a share stops the person opening it again. It cannot recall a copy they have already downloaded — the access log below is the record of what was opened and when.

recipient.label: Share with
recipient.minLength: Type at least {count} characters to search.
recipient.empty: Nobody matching that can receive a shared document.
recipient.hint: Pick as many people as you need. Each gets their own share, which you can revoke separately.

dialog.title: Share {count, plural, one {this document} other {# documents}}
dialog.descriptionOne: Give the people you pick view-and-download access to “{title}”. Nothing else in your documents becomes visible to them.
dialog.descriptionMany: Give the people you pick view-and-download access to {count} documents. Each document and each person gets its own share, and nothing else in your documents becomes visible to them.

fields.expiresAtHint: Leave empty to share with no end date. You can revoke at any time.

dialog.share: Share {recipientCount, plural, =0 {} one {with 1 person} other {with # people}}
dialog.success: Shared {count, plural, one {1 document} other {# documents}} with {recipientCount, plural, one {1 person} other {# people}}.

errors.noRecipient: Choose at least one person to share with.

panel.title: Sharing
panel.description: Who can open “{title}”, and what they have done with it.
panel.error: Could not load who this is shared with.
panel.empty: You have not shared this with anyone.

row.opened: Opened {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} · last on {lastAccessedAt}

sharedWithMe.title: Shared with me
sharedWithMe.subtitle: Documents other people have given you access to. Each can be withdrawn by its owner at any time.

states.error: Could not load documents shared with you.
states.emptyDescription: When somebody shares one of their documents with you, it appears here.

errors.download: Could not open this document. The share may have been withdrawn.

offboarding.title: Your documents will be deleted on {date}.
offboarding.body: Until then you can sign in to view, download, export and delete them, and do nothing else. Documents you have shared stay readable by the people you shared them with.
